title: Does the validation set still look like the training set? — feature_drift_check
text: Numeric features (frames) compared standardised mean shift: difference means training standard deviation, threshold unitless. Anything else compared total variation distance two frequency tables, 0-1. Missing values dropped first, feature fewer 20 usable values either frame, constant training, scored. One DRIFT_RISK result per drifted feature, largest shift first. Port FeatureDriftCheck bdp-model-gate 0.7.0. One deliberate difference: training column whose values identical always treated constant. Upstream tests standard deviation zero, rounding defeats values 0.1, reports shifts trillions.

code: # A check of your own: no feature may be entirely missing. no_empty_columns <- new_check("no_empty_columns", "validation", TRUE, function(context) {   empty <- names(context$X)[vapply(context$X, function(col) all(is.na(col)), logical(1))]   found <- length(empty) > 0   list(check_result("no_empty_columns", "validation",                     if (found) "EMPTY_COLUMN_RISK" else "OK",                     detail = paste("empty columns:", if (found) toString(empty) else "none"),                     blocking = TRUE)) }) report <- run_gate(gate_context(data.frame(a = 1:3, b = NA)), list(no_empty_columns)) gate_status(report) #> [1] "BLOCKED"

title: modelgate 0.7.0
text: Framework: gate_context(), new_check(), run_gate(), gate_report, verdict logic exit codes, matching bdp-model-gate 0.7.0. First check: split_overlap_check() (category validation, blocking). Second check: validation_strategy_check() (category validation, blocking), compliance_config() high-risk use cases. Runs default skips reason model card. Third check: feature_drift_check() (category validation, non-blocking): standardised mean shift numeric features, total variation distance rest. Runs default. Two deliberate differences upstream, listed README. Fourth check: feature_contract_check() (category validation, blocking): columns missing X, columns seen training, right columns wrong order. gate_context() gains expected_features. Runs default. Fifth check: target_leakage_check() (category validation, blocking): feature whose solo predictive power rivals model’s. Binary continuous targets. gate_context() gains task. Runs first default. Deliberate differences upstream listed README. Every exported function runnable example, package documentation website (pkgdown).
